🎮 Dreamscape Memory — Play & Leaderboard

Practise every Dreamscape Memory scene under a 60-second timer and compete on the public leaderboard. Looking for the full event guide and item names? Head to the wiki page.

🗺️ Dreamscape Memory Season 5 is live

Season 5 has started in-game and we're mapping it live — new scenes go into Play mode within hours of release, same as every season before it. Every Season 4 scene (Docks, Dining Car, Snow Lodge, Chinese Temple, the Conquering Sword co-op, and more) stays fully playable on the public leaderboard too.

Heads up: Season 5's lineup varies by state — WoS brought back scenes from earlier seasons instead of giving every state the same set. If the scene you're playing isn't under Season 5, check the earlier seasons below — they're all still mapped and playable.

🏆 Leaderboard

Best score per player for the selected map and stage. Higher score = more items found, faster, with fewer wrong clicks and hints. Logged-in players who opt in have their score published under their chosen public name — no real names or emails are ever shown.

▶ Play

Open a map and hit Play. You'll get three random items at a time under a 60-second timer, with up to three hints. Every wrong click and every hint costs points; seconds left at the buzzer give you a bonus.

⚠️ Translations are auto-generated and may not match the exact terms used in-game. The English item names are the reference — pick the language that helps you spot the item, then cross-check against the screenshot.

✨ Current Season — Season 5

Season 5 scenes use precise item hit-areas — boxes shaped to each object, rotated where needed — so taps register exactly on the target. New scenes join within hours of release. (Season 5's lineup varies by state — if your scene isn't here, check the earlier seasons below.)
